snippet.title: Kumarn: The Wandering Spirit - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the Announcement Trailer for Kumarn: The Wandering Spirit, an upcoming Thai-inspired horror game developed by WereBuff Studio. Players will explore Thai temples, shrines, graveyards, and haunted villages with Southeast Asian mythological themes as Kumran. Embark on a surreal journey to return Kumran home after dark forces kidnap him. Engage in stealth mechanics, solve puzzles, and progress through six chapters with distinct visuals. Kumarn: The Wandering Spirit is coming soon to PC (Steam).
